newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 91-day T-bill rate rises to 10.392 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 91-day T-bill rate rises to 10.392 pct.

text.p: The Philippine benchmark 91-day treasury bill rate rose to 10.392 percent at the regular weekly auction on Monday from 10.107 percent last week, the Bureau of Treasury said.
The coupon rate on the 182-day bill rose to 10.726 percent from 10.546.
The 364-day bill rose to 11.396 percent from 11.112.
The treasury received 4.435 billion pesos worth of tenders for the three-month bills of which one billion was accepted.

Tenders worth 3.430 billion pesos were received for the six-month bills of which 1.5 billion was accepted and tenders worth 8.255 billion were received for the one-year bills of which 2.0 billion was accepted.
